import csv
import random

# List of categories
categories = ["Electronics", "Fashion", "Home Goods", "Toys", "Sports"]

# List of brands
brands = ["Apple", "Samsung", "Nike", "Adidas", "Sony"]

# List of prices
prices = [10.99, 20.99, 30.99, 40.99, 50.99]

# List of stock levels
stock_levels = [100, 200, 300, 400, 500]

# Generate 14 rows of data
data = []
for i in range(14):
    product_id = i + 1
    category = random.choice(categories)
    brand = random.choice(brands)
    price = random.choice(prices)
    stock = random.choice(stock_levels)
    special_char = chr(random.randint(33, 126))  # Generate a random printable character
    data.append([product_id, category, brand, price, stock, f'"{special_char}"'])

# Write the data to a CSV file
with open('data.csv', 'w', newline='') as csvfile:
    writer = csv.writer(csvfile)
    writer.writerow(["ProductID", "Category", "Brand", "Price", "Stock", "Special Character"])  # Write the header row
    writer.writerows(data)
